text: 金十数据10月16日讯，法国财政部长罗兰·莱斯屈尔表示，当前金融市场动荡正促使法国各政治派别认识到财政审慎的重要性，他对议会最终通过政府提出的预算案持乐观态度。莱斯屈尔表示：“全世界都在关注我们。除了极左翼那些疯狂的人之外，议会中的所有人都意识到，我们必须推进财政整顿。”他坦言，高企的债券收益率在一定程度上帮助他推动各方正视财政问题。法国国民议会本周开始审议2027年预算案。然而，法国议会内部严重分裂，加之距离总统选举仅剩约六个月，各方达成妥协面临较大困难。如果预算案无法获得通过，政府仍可援引宪法第49.3条绕过议会投票，但可能因此面临不信任投票并被迫下
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 — French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said that current financial market turmoil is prompting France's political factions to recognize the importance of fiscal prudence, and he is optimistic that parliament will ultimately pass the government's budget proposal. Lescure said: “The whole world is watching us. Apart from the crazies on the far left, everyone in parliament realizes that we must advance fiscal consolidation.” He acknowledged that high bond yields have helped him push all parties to face fiscal issues. France's National Assembly began reviewing the 2027 budget this week. However, the French parliament is deeply divided, and with only about six months left before the presidential election, reaching a compromise is difficult. If the budget cannot be passed, the government can still invoke Article 49.3 of the constitution to bypass a parliamentary vote, but it may then face a no-confidence vote and be forced to step down
